purpose: Seed the independent Paperclip commerce company with current marketplace demand signals. Marketplace observations are category evidence only and never prove PrismBay product identity, profit, supplier readiness, or checkout readiness.

sources.signal: Current Best Sellers and high-demand product research includes phone accessories, under-cabinet lights, kitchen and automotive products.
Best Seller examples include car headrest hooks, car trash cans, microfiber cleaning cloths, knife brushes and collapsible microwave covers.
Search-demand-based dropshipping categories remain strong across kitchen, pet, home, tools, phone accessories and car accessories.
Q4 is a major retail period and October is an early preparation window for holiday shopping, increasing the value of products that can be verified, fulfilled and shipped quickly.
Cleaning Day Bundle showed roughly 302K sold. Cleaning content remains a major social-commerce demand cluster.

Cordless vacuums, disposable toilet scrubber systems and mattress vacuums show strong observed sell-through. Toilet scrubber kit roughly 184.8K sold and mattress vacuum roughly 123.5K sold in surfaced listings.
Cordless electric spin scrubber listing surfaced with roughly 54K sold, reinforcing demand for demonstrable cleaning tools.
Portable mini bag sealer surfaced with roughly 18.8K sold and simple hand-push kitchen whisk with roughly 19.4K sold.
Car seat-gap filler organizers surfaced with roughly 44.3K sold and car armrest organizer products with tens of thousands sold, supporting compact non-electrical vehicle-organization demand.
A five-piece stiff-bristle crevice brush set surfaced with roughly 34.7K sold. This is category-level demand evidence only and is not proof that the PrismBay Crevice Brush is the same product.
A bathroom sink drain strainer and hair-catcher listing surfaced with roughly 37.8K sold, indicating active demand for compact drain hair-catcher products.

Reusable pet-hair removal tools remain active; an electrostatic reusable remover glove surfaced with roughly 22.9K sold and a multi-tool remover with roughly 9.6K sold. This is category demand, not product-identity proof.
Cleaning and vacuum products remain prominent, including handheld vacuums, portable carpet cleaners and mop/refill systems.
Product Research and Sourcing Insights are intended to identify high-demand and relatively undersupplied categories.

candidates.name: Crevice cleaning brush set
candidates.reason: Strong fresh category demand, tiny parcel profile, obvious demonstration value, and an existing PrismBay Clean store SKU. Exact CJ supplier/variant identity, destination freight and verified unit economics still control commercialization.

candidates.name: Reusable pet hair removal tool
candidates.reason: Fresh social-commerce demand, compact non-consumable formats and strong before/after demonstration potential. Existing PrismBay Clean SKU reduces storefront setup work but does not waive supplier, rights, freight or checkout gates.

candidates.name: Disposable toilet scrubber brush kit
candidates.reason: Exceptional observed social-commerce sell-through, compact format, obvious demonstration value and refill/bundle potential. Avoid chemical refills unless independently reviewed.

candidates.name: Drain hair catcher and strainer
candidates.reason: Fresh demand evidence, compact shipping, simple problem/solution creative and an existing PrismBay Clean store SKU. Fit dimensions and exact supplier identity must be verified before sale.

candidates.name: Microfiber car detailing cloth kit
candidates.reason: Cross-market automotive demand, low complexity and bundle-friendly economics. Differentiate by count, GSM, weave and task-specific pack composition.

candidates.name: Car seat headrest hooks
candidates.reason: Compact problem-solving accessory with broad vehicle fit and strong before/after creative potential.

candidates.name: Car seat gap filler organizer
candidates.reason: Fresh observed social-commerce demand and strong visual problem/solution fit. Require honest fit dimensions and compatibility language to reduce returns.

candidates.name: Portable mini snack bag sealer
candidates.reason: Strong observed sell-through, low ticket, small parcel and immediate demonstration value. Electrical/battery quality needs verification before launch.

candidates.name: Knife and cutlery cleaning brush
candidates.reason: Small, inexpensive problem-solver in a resilient kitchen category. Product design and safe-use copy must be reviewed.

candidates.name: Compact car trash can
candidates.reason: Clear problem/solution creative and broad vehicle applicability. Confirm packed dimensions and mounting compatibility.

candidates.name: Collapsible microwave food cover
candidates.reason: Popular kitchen problem-solver with compact collapsible format. Require documented material and food-contact suitability.

candidates.name: Cordless electric spin scrubber
candidates.reason: Strong current social-commerce validation. Existing PrismBay product should be benchmarked against observed market price and product quality rather than assumed viable.

candidates.name: Mattress vacuum
candidates.reason: High observed sell-through but heavier freight, electronics and performance expectations make it a higher-risk test than small manual products.
